use_cases.name: Analyse skills gaps and act on recommended learning and hiring
use_cases.goal: Show current versus required skills by role, team and site and turn agent-recommended learning and hiring actions into approved, ledgered changes.

stakeholders.interest: Knows which skills the line lacks before a new product launch and how the gap will close.
Approves hiring only where learning cannot close the gap in time.
Can see which recommendations were accepted, by whom, and what changed as a result.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations opens skills gap analysis, or a new role profile is published for a planned line.
preconditions: Role profiles define required skills and proficiency levels.
Employee skill profiles are populated from assessments, certifications and inferred skills confirmed by the employee or manager.
The skills agent runs as an agent principal whose tools can read the skills projection and propose assignments and requisitions.
postconditions_success: Approved learning assignments and requisitions exist in their owning services and each action is recorded in the action ledger.
postconditions_failure: Rejected recommendations are recorded with reason and nothing is assigned or raised.

main_flow.action: Selects the role CNC programmer for the new aerospace line at Peenya Works and the team of 26 programmers and setters.
Reads the skills analytics projection and compares each person's proficiency with the role profile.
Shows a heatmap of required versus current proficiency by skill, team and site, with gap counts.
Recommends actions: assign 5-axis programming path to 9 people, and raise 2 requisitions where no internal candidate is within reach in 6 months.
Passes each recommended write through the policy gate and shows the dry-run: who gets which path and which requisitions would be raised.
Reviews and confirms the learning assignments, removing one person on long leave.
Approves the 2 requisitions through the approval engine.
Creates the 8 assignments and 2 requisitions and records each in the action ledger with recommendation, approver and reversal handle.
Tracks gap closure monthly as learners complete paths and certifications.

alternate_flows.condition: The recommended assignments are within the tenant auto-approval threshold of 10 learners and no cost.
steps: Platform assigns them without separate approval and records the threshold applied in the action ledger.

exception_flows.condition: The proposed change exceeds the auto-resolve threshold.
exception_flows.handling: The agent may only propose; the change waits for a human decision.

exception_flows.condition: A bulk assignment exceeds the blast-radius cap of 50 learners.
exception_flows.handling: The action is denied and recorded with reason.

exception_flows.condition: A recommendation would require reading data outside declared tools, such as individual pay.
exception_flows.handling: The plan is rejected; the agent uses only declared tools.

exception_flows.condition: A created assignment fails the post-execution check because the learner already holds the path.
exception_flows.handling: The action is reversed using the handle and the failure is recorded.

nfrs: The heatmap for 3,000 employees and 400 skills renders within 4 s at p95.
Every recommendation states the evidence used, such as assessment date or certification.

user_stories.want: a heatmap of required versus current skills for a role at one site
user_stories.so_that: I can plan training before the new line starts

acceptance.given: the CNC programmer profile requires 5-axis programming at level 3 and 17 of 26 people are at level 1 or 2
acceptance.then: the heatmap shows a gap of 17 for that skill at Peenya Works

acceptance.given: a manager has not confirmed an inferred skill
acceptance.then: the unconfirmed skill is excluded and counted separately

user_stories.want: to confirm agent-recommended learning assignments from a dry-run
user_stories.so_that: nothing is assigned without my decision

acceptance.given: the agent recommends the 5-axis path for 9 people, within the cap of 50
acceptance.then: 8 assignments are created and each appears in the action ledger with my confirmation

acceptance.given: a recommendation covers 60 learners against a cap of 50
acceptance.then: it is denied and recorded with the reason

user_stories.want: to trace a requisition back to the recommendation and approval that raised it
user_stories.so_that: I can verify the agent acted within policy

acceptance.given: requisition REQ-2026-131 was raised from a skills recommendation
acceptance.when: I open its action ledger entry
acceptance.then: I see the recommendation, the dry-run, the approver and the time of approval
the reversal is linked to the original action

use_cases.name: Analyse collaboration networks from consented, aggregated metadata
use_cases.goal: Identify silos and connecting teams from consented collaboration metadata, aggregated above privacy thresholds and never using message or meeting content.

stakeholders.interest: Takes part only with consent, can withdraw at any time, and is never ranked or judged individually.
Sees where sites or functions work in isolation, for example between engineering at Pune and production at Medchal Works.
Approves the study scope, data sources and retention before any data is read.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations proposes a network study, for example on the handover between design engineering and plant production.
preconditions: A study charter defines purpose, population, metadata sources, thresholds and a 90-day retention, approved by the tenant admin and the data protection lead (to be validated by Legal).
Connectors to the corporate calendar and the business messaging channel are declared tools limited to sender, recipient, time and count.
Employees in scope have been asked for consent under the DPDP Act 2023.
postconditions_success: A team-level network map and findings are published to authorised viewers, and raw metadata is deleted at the end of retention.
postconditions_failure: The study does not run if consent coverage is below the configured minimum.

main_flow.action: Submits the study charter for the design-to-production handover across Pune and Medchal Works.
Approves the charter through the approval engine with the data protection lead.
Requests consent from the 420 employees in scope, explaining that only counts and timing are used, never content.
Collects 8 weeks of metadata only for consenting employees through the declared connectors.
Pseudonymises identities and aggregates interactions to team level, applying a minimum of 8 people per node.
Computes cross-team link strength, isolated teams and bridging teams.
Reviews findings and adds interventions such as a weekly design-production stand-up.
Views the team-level map and approves the interventions.
Deletes raw metadata at day 90 and keeps only the aggregated results.

alternate_flows.condition: An individual has opted in to be named as a connector for a recognition programme.
steps: Platform shows that person's name only in the recognition view and only with their opt-in recorded.

exception_flows.condition: Consent coverage is below 60% of the population.
exception_flows.handling: The study does not proceed and HR is told the coverage.

exception_flows.condition: A team node has fewer than 8 consenting members.
exception_flows.handling: It is merged into its parent unit or suppressed.

exception_flows.condition: A connector tool returns content fields such as message text.
exception_flows.handling: The tool call is rejected by the policy gate and the connector is disabled pending review.

exception_flows.condition: An employee withdraws consent during the study.
exception_flows.handling: Their metadata is deleted within 24 hours and excluded from results.

nfrs: No output, export or agent answer contains an individual node unless that person opted in to be named.
Raw metadata is deleted within 24 hours of the retention end date.

user_stories.want: to consent to the network study knowing exactly what is collected

acceptance.given: I receive the consent request for the design-production study
acceptance.then: it states that only sender, recipient, time and count are used, never content, and that data is deleted after 90 days
my metadata is deleted within 24 hours

user_stories.want: a team-level map showing isolated and bridging teams
user_stories.so_that: I can fix handover problems between sites

acceptance.given: the study covers 31 teams with at least 8 consenting members each
acceptance.then: design engineering Pune and production Medchal show a weak link with link strength in the bottom 10%
that team is merged into its parent unit

use_cases.name: Show context metrics embedded in transactional screens
use_cases.goal: Display metrics relevant to the decision on the screen, within the viewer's scope, such as team absence trend beside a leave approval.

stakeholders.interest: Decides approvals with coverage and trend in view, without opening a separate report.
Configures which metric widgets appear on which screen for the tenant.
Personal data shown in context never exceeds what the viewer may already see.

use_cases.trigger: A user opens a transactional screen that has context widgets configured.
preconditions: Context widgets are registered with the screen, metric, scope rule and minimum group size.
Analytics projections for the metrics are refreshed on their configured schedule.
postconditions_success: The screen shows its widgets with the projection timestamp, scoped to the viewer.
postconditions_failure: When a widget cannot load, the screen states that context is unavailable and the transaction remains usable.

main_flow.action: Opens a leave request from E1066 for 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-25 at Peenya Works.
Looks up the context widgets registered for the screen: team absence trend, overlap on the dates and shift coverage.
Resolves the viewer's scope and queries the analytics projections within it.
Shows an 8-week team absence trend, 3 others already approved for 2026-11-24 and shift A coverage dropping to 82%.
Drills into the coverage figure to see the roster for those dates within the team.
Approves the request with the context in view.
Records which widgets were shown with the decision for later review.

alternate_flows.condition: An implementation consultant adds a widget to the overtime approval screen.
steps: Consultant selects the metric and scope rule in configuration and previews it as a sample manager.
The widget appears for all managers after publishing.

exception_flows.condition: A metric would cover fewer than 5 people, such as team wellbeing scores.
exception_flows.handling: The widget is suppressed and shows the minimum-size notice.

exception_flows.condition: The projection is unavailable or older than its freshness limit.
exception_flows.handling: The widget shows Context unavailable or the data age, and the approval remains possible.

exception_flows.condition: The drill-through would leave the viewer's scope.
exception_flows.handling: The drill stops at the scope boundary.

nfrs: Widgets load within 800 ms at p95 and never delay the transactional form from rendering.
Each widget shows the timestamp of the projection it used.

user_stories.want: team absence and coverage shown beside a leave request
user_stories.so_that: I can approve without opening another report

acceptance.given: 3 team members are approved on leave on 2026-11-24 and shift A has 22 rostered
acceptance.then: the widget shows 3 overlapping absences and coverage of 82% for that day
the widget shows Context unavailable and I can still approve

user_stories.want: to add a context widget to a screen through configuration
user_stories.so_that: the tenant gets relevant metrics without custom development

acceptance.given: I add monthly overtime hours per worker to the overtime approval screen
acceptance.when: I preview it as a sample supervisor at Chakan Works
acceptance.then: it shows only that supervisor's team

acceptance.given: I configure a wellbeing metric with minimum group size 5
acceptance.when: a manager of 4 opens the screen
